senses.gloss: (cmp. גָּנַן to surround; with על, to cover. Denom. גַּוָּן.

units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>מה המגן הזה מֵגִין את … מֵגִין על וכ׳</he> as the shield surrounds the body, so does the Lord protect man.

<cite ref="Sotah 10a">Sot. 10ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>מה הקב״ה מגין על … אף שמשון ה׳ וכ׳</he> as the Lord protects the whole world, so did Samson in his generation protect Israel; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 69">Yalk. Jud. 69</cite>.
